DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次は三列目をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please do the third row next.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: どちら側から数えた三列目ですか。私たちで数え方が違っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 列番号の基点を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Counting from which side? We were counting in different ways.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where the row numbering starts. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 道側を一列目にしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The row by the road is row one.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私が終えたのは水路側から二列目です。図で指してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別基点での作業範囲を図示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The row I've finished is the second counting from the irrigation-channel side. May I point it out on a diagram?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your work area using the other starting point on a diagram. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お願いします。作業済みの場所を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do. Let's check which areas are finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この二列です。まだ作業していないのは中央の列ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未作業の列を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: These two rows. The one we haven't worked on is the middle row, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the row that has not been worked on. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。そこを担当してください。

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 道側からの番号をメモして、隣の人にも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 統一した番号を共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll note the numbering from the road side and tell the person next to me, too.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Share the agreed row numbering. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 途中で境目が分からなくなったら止めて聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you lose track of the boundary during the work, stop and ask.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。推測で隣の列まで進めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明時に停止して聞くと約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll make sure not to guess and carry on into the neighboring row.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Promise to stop and ask if unsure. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当列がそろいました。中央の列からお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've aligned our assigned rows. Please start with the middle row.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 全体を回る案内をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like a guide to the full route?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予定が変わって、三十分しか歩けなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 滞在時間の変更を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: My plans changed, and now I can only walk around for thirty minutes.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the change in how long you can stay. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの場所を見たいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which place would you like to see?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口から見える石垣です。そこを中心にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 優先する見学対象を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The stone wall visible from the entrance. I'd like to focus on that.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the main sight you want to prioritize. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 全体の経路では時間が足りませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: There won't be enough time for the full route, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 遠い場所を省いて、入口へ戻る短い経路を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 往復の短い経路を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please skip the distant places and show me a short route that returns to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a short route out and back. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この図で、往復する道を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the outward and return paths on this map.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ道で戻ります。案内の残りは資料で読みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 省いた説明を資料で補う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll return by the same path. I'd like to read the rest of the information in the handout.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use written materials for the explanations omitted from the visit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料はこちらです。帰りの時刻も見ておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the handout. Please also keep an eye on your return time.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 歩き始めた時刻を記録して、十五分たったら戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 引返し時点を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll record when I start walking and turn back after fifteen minutes.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide when you will turn back. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、短い経路で無理なくご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please enjoy the short route at a comfortable pace.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall I make it into a bouquet?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 相手の家に花瓶がないので、別の形にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受取人の花瓶不足を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The recipient doesn't have a vase at home. Could you arrange it another way?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the recipient has no vase. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 器付きで飾れる形もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We also have arrangements that come in a container for display.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、その形でお願いします。机に置くので大きすぎないものがいいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 飾る形と大きさを指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'd like that style. It will go on a desk, so something not too large would be good.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the arrangement style and size. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: このくらいの幅はどうですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ちょうどいいです。持ち運ぶとき、横にしても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち運ぶ向きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's just right. When carrying it, is it all right to lay it on its side?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask which way up to carry it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 傾けずに持つほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's better to carry it without tilting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 平らに置ける袋をお願いします。車でも倒れない場所に置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 水平に運べる包装を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please give me a bag in which it can sit level. I'll put it somewhere in the car where it won't tip over, too.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for packaging that lets you carry it level. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お手入れの説明も付けましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like care instructions included?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分で説明を変えず、その紙を相手に渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手入れ説明を相手へ渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll give the recipient that sheet rather than change the explanation myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pass the care instructions on to the recipient. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、器付きでまとめて説明を添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll arrange it in a container and include the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 田中さんは資材の確認をお願いします。

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 田中が二人います。私ともう一人のどちらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同姓の二人による曖昧さを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two people named Tanaka. Do you mean me or the other one?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the ambiguity caused by two people having the same surname. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日はあなたにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today I'd like you to do it.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 担当表には姓だけなので、名前まで入れてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 担当表の氏名追記を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The assignment chart only has surnames. Could you add my given name, too?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for your full name to be added to the assignment chart. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 追記します。場所は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll add it. Do you know the location?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 資材置場は分かります。確認する項目をもう一度お願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認項目を聞き直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I know where the materials storage area is. Please tell me again which things to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask again which items you should check. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 数量と伝票の一致です。足りなければ責任者へ報告してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check that the quantities match the paperwork. If anything is short, report to the supervisor.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 数量と伝票を見て、不足があれば持ち出さず報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不一致時の報告手順を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check the quantities and paperwork, and if there's a shortage, report it without taking the materials out.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Repeat the reporting procedure for a mismatch. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: もう一人の田中さんにも、担当が別だと伝えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's also tell the other Tanaka that you have different assignments.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二人で表の追記を確認してから、それぞれの持ち場へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人で担当を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The two of us will check the added names on the chart before each going to our own work area.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the assignments together with the other person. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、氏名と担当を確認して作業を始めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please confirm the names and assignments before starting work.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この二枚をお出しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be sending these two cards?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。昨日書いたので、日付も昨日です。今日に直すべきか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: カードの記入日と発送日の違いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I wrote them yesterday, so the date is yesterday, too. I'm not sure whether I should change it to today.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between the card's written date and mailing date. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 文面の日付は、何の日を表していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: What day does the date in the message refer to?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 旅の出来事を書いた日です。出す日とは違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 記載日が出来事の記録と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The day I wrote down the events of my trip. That's different from the day I send it, isn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the written date records the events. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その意図が分かるように書けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can write it so that your intention is clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、日付は残して「昨日の旅の記録」と一言添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 日付を残し意味を補う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll leave the date and add a short note saying 'a record of yesterday's trip.'
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep the date and clarify its meaning. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: もう一枚も同じ日に書きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Did you write the other card on the same day, too?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そちらは一昨日です。全部同じ日付にしないで、別々に見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二枚を一律に直さず区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: That one was the day before yesterday. Rather than make all the dates the same, I'll check them separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the two cards instead of changing both in the same way. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宛名と切手も一枚ずつご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check each address and stamp separately, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二人の宛名は合っています。文面もそれぞれの日付のまま送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛名と各文面を照合して差し出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both recipients' addresses are correct. I'll also send each message with its own original date.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the addresses and individual messages before mailing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その二枚の発送について確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll check the mailing arrangements for those two cards.

DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その荷物をお預けになりますか。
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to leave that luggage with us?

DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも、付いている札は友人のものです。
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 識別札の誤りを知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But the tag attached to it belongs to my friend.
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the incorrect identifying tag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋も入れ替わっていますか。
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have the bags been switched, too?

DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋は私のものです。札だけ付け間違えました。
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋と札の所有を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-04.translation: The bag is mine. I only attached the wrong tag.
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish who owns the bag and the tag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、預ける前に直してください。
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then please correct it before leaving it with us.

DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人に確認して、自分の札に付け直します。
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者と札を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll check with my friend and replace it with my own tag.
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct the tag together with your companion. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 壊れやすい物は入っていますか。

DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小さい瓶があります。それだけ手元の袋に移します。
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 壊れ物を手荷物に移す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-08.translation: There's a small bottle. I'll move just that into the bag I'm keeping with me.
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Move the fragile item into your hand luggage. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 移し終わってからお預かりします。
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll take the bag once you've finished moving it.

DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 札も中身も確認できました。この袋を預けます。
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認後に預ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked both the tag and the contents. I'll leave this bag with you.
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Leave the luggage after checking it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、この荷物をお預かりします。
DLG-SC-ISK-KOMATSU-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll hold this luggage for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この部品は合格ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだ判断できません。測るたびに数値が変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 判定できない理由を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't judge yet. The reading changes every time I measure it.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain why you cannot make a judgment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ位置で測りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you measure at the same position?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。三回分を順番に記録しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 測定条件と回数を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I've recorded the three measurements in order.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the measurement conditions and number of measurements. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 測定器の確認が必要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check the measuring instrument, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 基準用の品で確かめてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 基準品による確認を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: May I check it using a reference item?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Suggest checking with a reference item. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 手順を担当者に確認してからにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the procedure with the responsible staff first.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、部品を不良扱いせず、判定待ちに分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 部品の判定を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll separate the part as awaiting judgment rather than treat it as defective.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Put the judgment on the part on hold. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録も残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please leave a record as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 数値と測定器の番号を添えて担当者に渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 測定器番号付きの記録を渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll give the staff the readings together with the measuring instrument's number.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the record including the measuring instrument number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記録を受け取ります。確認まで出荷判断は保留します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take the record. We'll hold off on deciding to ship it until the check is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 二つとも同じ模様にしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like the same pattern on both items?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一つは自分用、もう一つは姉への贈り物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二つの用途を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: One is for me, and the other is a gift for my older sister.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese what each of the two items is for.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 色だけ変えても区別できますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You could tell them apart just by using different colors.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 姉は細かい柄が好きなので、模様も変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取人の好みで模様を変える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: My sister likes detailed patterns, so I'd like to change the pattern too.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to change the pattern to suit the recipient's taste.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 先に紙に描いてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's try drawing them on paper first.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 片方は細い線、私のほうは大きな丸にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二種類の構図を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll use fine lines on one and large circles on mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe in Japanese the design you have chosen for each item.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 道具を共有するので、順番に進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The tools are shared, so please take turns using them.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、姉の分を先に作ってから道具を渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 共有道具の使用順を調整する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll make my sister's item first and pass the tools on afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss in Japanese who will use the shared tools first and who will use them next.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 仕上げる前に二つを並べて見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before we finish, let's put the two items side by side and take a look.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 違いが分かります。この組合せで仕上げたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 並べて最終案を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can see the difference. I'd like to finish them with this combination.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare the two items side by side and say in Japanese which final designs you choose.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、それぞれの模様を残して仕上げましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's finish the two items, keeping each one's pattern.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらのお茶がお好みでしたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 香りが強いほうです。でも名前を忘れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 好みの印象と名前の不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The one with the stronger aroma. But I've forgotten its name.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe in Japanese what you liked about the tea and explain that you cannot remember its name.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 先に飲んだほうでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Was it the one you drank first?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。最初の一杯を指しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 試飲順で対象を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I mean the first cup I tried.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese which tea you mean by referring to the order you tasted them in.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それはこちらです。もう一方と並べますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's this one. I'll put it beside the other tea.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前をメモして、もう一度香りだけ比べていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名前の記録と再比較を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: May I write down the name and compare just the aromas once more?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese if you may write down the name and compare the teas again.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。味の印象も違いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of course. Did they taste different, too?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 最初はすっきりして、次は少し甘く感じました。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 味の違いを表現する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The first tasted clean and refreshing, and the next seemed a little sweet.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe in Japanese how the two teas tasted different.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どちらをお選びになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Which would you like to choose?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は最初のお茶を少量買って、家でも試します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 少量購入で試すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I'll buy a small amount of the first tea and try it at home, too.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have decided to buy a small amount of tea to try.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その茶葉を少量お包みします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll pack a small amount of those tea leaves for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会計は済みました。薬味をどう取るのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計済みと操作の疑問を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've already paid. I don't know how to take the condiments.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you've paid and ask how to use the condiment station. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの専用スプーンを使います。

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の箸では取らないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 共用器具の使い分けを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I shouldn't use my own chopsticks to take them, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the proper use of the shared utensils. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。スプーンは元の場所へ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. Please return the spoon to its original place.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 少しずつ取って、足りなければ後で足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 少量ずつ取る方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll take a little at a time and add more later if it isn't enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will take small amounts at a time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 熱い丼を持ったままだと危ないですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's dangerous while holding a hot bowl.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: トレーを置いてから取ります。置く場所はこちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 丼を置く場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll put the tray down before taking any. Is this the place to put it?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask where to put the bowl down. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。後ろの方も使うので、取ったら席へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. People behind you need to use it too, so please go to your seat once you've taken some.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 薬味を取りました。スプーンを戻して席へ運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 器具を戻して移動する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've taken the condiments. I'll put the spoon back and carry my food to my seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return the utensil and move on. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、足元に気を付けてお運びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take care as you carry it, and watch your step.
